game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Fairy Ring Glade Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round, bog toads strike the fairy lantern, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the fairy lantern from bog toads in Fairy Ring Glade: keep the roll_call meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: roll_call drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how roll_call changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Fairy Ring Glade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while roll_call > 0.
